assertions.text: The response does not treat the first poll's completed/failure result as this retry's terminal outcome, because its attempt (1) equals the baseline rather than exceeding it
The response continues polling after the first call rather than stopping and reporting a failure
The response does not require having separately observed queued/in_progress before trusting the eventual attempt-2 result
The response trusts the third poll's completed/success result (attempt 2, exceeding the baseline) and reports success
